##### Project general facts

Sunrise Bay by Emaar Properties is a premium twin-tower residential development located within Emaar Beachfront. Rising 26 storeys, the project is positioned just steps away from the marina and the beachfront, offering a refined coastal lifestyle framed by open sea and waterfront views. The architecture blends seamlessly with its surroundings, reflecting a modern yachting-inspired aesthetic that enhances its prime seaside setting.

The development is thoughtfully designed to maximize panoramic views of the marina and the Arabian Gulf, with apartment layouts carefully oriented to capture natural light and uninterrupted vistas. Inspired by contemporary coastal living, the design combines elegance and simplicity, creating a calm and sophisticated residential atmosphere that reflects a modern beachfront lifestyle.

The interiors feature modern finishing with high-quality materials and a refined palette of soft creams, greys, and whites that enhance the sense of space and light. Open layouts and large windows create a seamless connection to the outdoors, while kitchens are equipped with appliances. The apartments are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Emaar Beachfront is an exclusive and luxurious beachfront community located in Dubai. Developed by Emaar Properties, one of the region's most renowned developers, this exquisite destination offers a harmonious blend of upscale living, stunning views, and a beachside lifestyle.

Emaar Beachfront is strategically situated between Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah, offering residents easy access to some of the city's most iconic landmarks and entertainment hubs. The community spans across a pristine shoreline, providing residents with direct access to the sparkling waters of the Arabian Gulf and the warm sandy beaches.

Emaar Beachfront also boasts an array of world-class amenities and facilities. Residents can indulge in a resort-style living experience with access to swimming pools, fitness centers, gourmet dining options, and lush landscaped gardens. The community is designed to offer a holistic lifestyle, combining relaxation, recreation, and convenience within a picturesque setting.
